title: Hearing Buddy Bolden and the blues
summary: He heard Bolden, whose players played by ear; everyone played the blues.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Where the blues came from: Handy, Bolden and early blues

blocks.x: Ask if they ever heard Buddy Bolden play. You ever heard Buddy Bolden play? You ever heard Buddy Bolden play?
You ever heard Buddy Bolden play?
Ah, I heard him play. Yeah, I heard him play.
When did he start? Was it later than the... When did he start?

I couldn't tell you. That was from a way they come there, you know. Go and come like that. And on the way going and coming, they make up a band. But they wasn't all really musicians, you know. They played by head.
Ask him who played by head. Who were some of the guys who played by head?
Do you know any of the fellas that played, that didn't play music, just played by head?
No, I didn't. It's hard to find out, you know.
Ah, tell him I heard of him. Heard of him?
He said he heard of him. He's too young to know him.
He used to play by head. That's the first time you heard any blues. When was the first time?
When was the first time you heard him play blues when you started to play music? Do you remember? Play what?
The blues. Oh, that was common, that. Everybody was playing the blues.
